_about: Answers file for the srx400-zero-touch-mist skill. Copy to answers.json in a working folder outside the repository clone (mode 600). It holds no secrets: secrets are paths to local files (mode 600). Write mist.portal_host, mist.api_host and mist.token_file first (intake A1-A2): mist_api.py reads them at import. Fields marked 'filled by the agent' come from Mist API reads.
repo_path: <path of the cloned repository; default two levels above SKILL.md>

site.name: <branch site name>
site.site_id: <filled by the agent from the inventory>
site.auto_upgrade_window: <filled by the agent from GET /sites/{site_id}/setting, or none>

1.role: ISP 1, MNHA local-id 1, activeness-priority 200, DHCPv6 prefix delegation
1.mist_device_name: <filled by the agent from the inventory, e.g. SRX400-1>
1.mac: <filled by the agent from the inventory, 12 lowercase hex>
1.device_id: <filled by the agent from the inventory>
1.license_key_file: <path of node 1's key file, or null for none>
1.profile_id: <filled by the agent after the create>

2.mist_device_name: <filled by the agent from the inventory, e.g. SRX400-2>
2.mac: <filled by the agent from the inventory, 12 lowercase hex>
2.device_id: <filled by the agent from the inventory>
2.license_key_file: <path of node 2's key file, or null for none>
2.profile_id: <filled by the agent after the create>

hub.hub_profile_name: <filled by the agent from GET deviceprofiles?type=gateway>
hub.hub_device_id: <filled by the agent from the inventory>
hub.hub_site_id: <filled by the agent from the inventory>
hub.iot_prefix_unique_on_overlay: <yes|no: no other site advertises 10.10.60.0/24 over OrgOverlay; asked when IOT or HUB-SITE-NETS is reused>

tenant_plan: paper section 4.2 and the values of intake E1, unchanged

ipv6.node1_delegated_prefix: <the /60 ISP 1 delegates; never inside 2001:db8::/32, the documentation range of the file's example>

site_readiness.isp_dhcp: <yes|no: address, default route, DNS, 10-minute lease, no option 143, on both WANs>
site_readiness.isp1_dhcpv6: <yes|no: ISP 1 answers DHCPv6 on node 1's ge-0/0/2 with IA_NA and IA_PD and always delegates the /60 above>
site_readiness.lan_switch: <yes|no: one LAG per node, LACP active, no force-up, VLAN 10 untagged, 20-60 tagged, bridged>
site_readiness.cabling: <yes|no: ge-0/0/2 ISP, ge-0/0/3 LAG, ge-0/0/4 and ge-0/0/5 to the peer's same ports>
